class.name: NNCustomSearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Scriptable NQS search criterion for custom filtering and scoring logic.
class.description: Use when the built-in distance, angle, dot-product, and metadata criteria are not enough (for example, checking line of sight or custom gameplay properties). Override [method on_apply_criterion] to set [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.is_filtered] and [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.score] for each candidate node.

method.name: on_apply_criterion
method.description: Override to evaluate each candidate [param node]. Set [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.is_filtered] to [code]true[/code] to discard it, or set [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.score] to rank it (defaults to unfiltered with score [code]1.0[/code]).
